::: {#exr-follow-first}
#### Exploring as far as you can

Explore the office graph (@fig-office) from $a$ by these rules:

- from the vertex you are at, go to the first vertex in its list (@exm-adjacency-list) that you have not visited yet;
- when every vertex in its list has been visited, go back to the vertex you came from, and go on from there.

In what order do you visit the six vertices?

:::
